businesses.name: Fashion Unlimited
businesses.website: https://fashionunlimitedonline.com/ (directory listings also give (732) 940-9148; the batch record had no phone)
businesses.what_they_do: South Asian clothing boutique and WooCommerce web store selling kurtis, lehengas, salwar kameez, sarees, chaniya cholis and party wear, with free US shipping and a gift/return-gift angle. Physical shop at 1463 Finnegans Ln Unit 7 plus online orders.
businesses.customers: Indian-American women shopping for wedding, festival and party wear in central New Jersey, plus online buyers across the USA

size_signals.signal: Single unit in Finnegans Plaza; hours listed inconsistently across directories (one shows Mon-Thu/Sat 12-8, Sun 12-4, Friday closed)
WooCommerce catalogue with priced products (about $52-$75 visible on the home page) and customer accounts/wishlist
3.9-4.0 rating from about 30 reviews across directories (not a verified Google figure)

listing.reviews: about 30 (directory aggregation; not shown in limited Maps view)

website_review.primary_cta: 'SHOP NOW' / 'SEE MORE..' on hero slides; ADD TO CART on products
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Online cart and checkout only; no store appointment or fitting booking
website_review.trust_signals: Product photography, product tags, free-shipping and returns policy links, customer accounts - but no visible reviews, staff names or store photos
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Very stale: the banner still advertises 'SUMMER 2021 SALE' and the footer reads 'Copyright©FashionUnlimitedOnline2017'; colours and typography look like a 2017 theme
website_review.search_basics: Title is generic ('GET YOUR LATEST FASHION ONLINE IN USA') with no town or category, no meta description and no schema; category and product pages exist but are titled generically
top_issues: Contact Us page is broken - it displays the raw shortcode '[wpforms id="1888" title="true"]' instead of a form, so there is no working way to send a message
No phone number or hours in the header or on the contact page (address only in the footer, with a different 609 support number)
No LocalBusiness/Store schema, no meta description, and store hours that disagree across directories

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google listing has category 'Clothing store', website, phone and hours (opens 12 PM), but hours conflict across directories and there is no structured data. Answerable: product names and prices are text and shipping/returns pages exist, but no openingHours, no address in structured form, no meta description, and the site is visibly 2017-era. Bookable: a shopper's agent can add to cart and check out, but there is no working contact form, no click-to-call and no appointment/fitting request.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the broken contact page and publish one authoritative hours/address/phone block (including click-to-call) that matches the Google profile
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page renders the literal WPForms shortcode text; store hours disagree between the Google listing (opens 12 PM), find-open (Friday closed) and other directories

top_opportunities.opportunity: Refresh the storefront: current-season banners and copyright, plus title/meta naming South Asian fashion and North Brunswick
top_opportunities.evidence: 'SUMMER 2021 SALE' banner and '©FashionUnlimitedOnline2017' footer still live in Nov 2026; title has no town or category

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add Store/LocalBusiness JSON-LD plus a WhatsApp or SMS order-enquiry channel for sizes, custom stitching and wedding orders
top_opportunities.evidence: No ld+json on any page; the only contact route is a broken form and an unlinked phone number

scores.reasons: Broken contact page plus 2017-era branding and missing basics are a real, fixable gap, but this is a single small boutique with low review volume and thin margins, so budget is limited.

caveats: Pay Less Furniture and Dequora Furniture share the same Shopify section layout, room-category menu and 'LEAVE A REVIEW' Google link pattern - inference: same theme or web vendor for both. Not verified.

Scores are comparative within this batch of North Brunswick retail/service businesses, not absolute; ratings and review counts come from Google Maps where shown and from aggregators where noted, so counts are indicative.
data_gaps: Google Maps review counts were not displayed in the signed-out limited Maps view; counts were captured only where an aggregator (Birdeye, Loc8NearMe) showed them and are labelled as such.
Joyeria y Variedades Damary's services and hours could only be read from search snippets quoting its now-dead website; not confirmed on any live page.
Costello's Ace rating/review count came from a directory aggregation page, not from Google Maps directly.
